scenarios.name: Preserve recent-document selections between list and grid views

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
two recent parts are displayed in List View
the first part's row is checked
the user switches to Grid View
the first part's card is checked and highlighted
Open Selected and Remove Selected are displayed
the user checks the second part's card
the user switches back to List View
both parts' rows are checked and highlighted
Open Selected and Remove Selected remain displayed
